name: Mickey Mouse Funhouse
description: Mickey Mouse, and his friends – Minnie, Goofy, Donald, Daisy and Pluto – to Funny, an enchanted talking playhouse, who takes the Sensational Six on adventures of all types to unique worlds that inspire the imagination.

videos.title: Mickey the Brave!
videos.overview: To help them find out if dragons are good or bad, Funny takes Mickey, Minnie, and their friends to the Kingdom of Majestica, where they are transformed into knights, knaves, and princesses.

videos.title: Pirate Adventure
videos.overview: Mickey and friends join Captain Salty Bones in the biggest treasure hunt of all time.

videos.title: Dino Safari
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie, and friends visit Prehistoric World to dino-sit some dinosaur eggs. When the dinosaurs start hatching and running loose, it's a safari adventure to get all the babies back together.

videos.title: Homesick
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie and friends want to take Funny the funhouse on a picnic, but he isn’t feeling well.

videos.title: Goldfish Goofy!
videos.overview: Funny takes the gang to Underwater Ocean World, transforming them into merpeople.

videos.title: Spaced Out!
videos.overview: Funny turns into a rocket ship to take everyone to space.

videos.title: Treasure, Ahoy!
videos.overview: When Donald’s impatience causes him to lose his pool floaty, Funny takes the crew to find the Lost & Found Treasure Chest.

videos.title: Is There a Plumber in the House?!
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang help Funny feel comfortable seeing a plumber when he has a leaky faucet.

videos.title: A Fish Tale
videos.overview: When Funny takes the gang fishing, he warns them about the legendary Big Muddy, the largest catfish in Big Fish Swamp.

videos.title: Minnie Goes Ape!
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie and their friends return a baby gorilla to the Enchanted Rainforest.

videos.title: Dino Doggies
videos.overview: Mickey and Goofy take Pluto and Teddy to Prehistoric Land, a fantastical world filled with weird trees, volcanoes and dinosaurs.

videos.title: Troll Trouble
videos.overview: King Ludwig of Majestica needs Mickey and the gang’s help to find out why a grumpy troll is causing trouble in the kingdom.

videos.title: The Sunny Gulch Games
videos.overview: Daisy insists on playing fair when she agrees to compete in the Sunny Gulch Games with Wheezelene’s gang of weasels.

videos.title: Minnie's Big Delivery
videos.overview: When Mickey, Minnie and the gang travel to Cheesy Chip and Pepperoni Dale’s pizza place, they help deliver pizzas for Chip and Dale.

videos.title: The Wandrin' Warbler
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang head to Sunny Gulch to hear Wanda Warbler, the best country-western singer around, who has a tendency to wander off.

videos.title: Mickey and the Cornstalk
videos.overview: Mickey must wait to read his new book until after he attends the Fun and Fancy Faire.

videos.title: King Mickey
videos.overview: King Ludwig leaves Mickey in charge of Majestica while he goes out of town.

videos.title: Bottled Up!
videos.overview: Daisy takes a trip to the Razzle Dazzle Dunes where she turns into a genie and has to grant three wishes

videos.title: Minnie's Fairy Tale!
videos.overview: When Minnie transforms into a fairy, she has trouble finding her talent.

videos.title: Daisy & Goofy Clean-Up!
videos.overview: Daisy and Goofy must clean up to earn something good.

videos.title: Crayon World!
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie take Millie and Melody to Crayon World.

videos.title: Maybe I'm A Maze
videos.overview: Mortimer Mouse joins the gang for an adventure to the Land of Myth. Then, Goofy can't find his favorite socks, so Funny takes him to Lost & Found Island.

videos.title: The Big Funhouse Sleepover
videos.overview: Crystal Clearwater visits Hot Dog Hills to present the town with a clean water award. Then, Goofy hosts a sleepover and gets carried away with the guest list.

videos.title: Ducks Inn Trouble!
videos.overview: The gang travels to Majestica for a delicious pancake breakfast, only to discover a problem. Then, Minnie needs something special to wear to Funny's party.

videos.title: The Fantabulous Five (Plus One)!
videos.overview: Funny takes the friends to the city of Herotropolis, where they can each have their own superpowers.

videos.title: Mickey Meets Rocket Mouse!
videos.overview: Mickey’s hero, Rocket Mouse, invites Mickey and friends to join his team of mouse-stronauts.

videos.title: Pirate Adventure
videos.overview: Legendary pirate Captain Salty Bones invites Mickey, Minnie and friends to join the biggest treasure hunt ever to see if they can become true pirates.

videos.title: Fifty-Foot Pluto!
videos.overview: Franken-Pete needs help getting ready for the Pumpkin Carving Contest, but when Pluto helps, he accidentally gets zapped to giant size!

videos.title: A Big Giant Problem!
videos.overview: Mickey accidentally breaks Minnie's kite.

videos.title: The Enchanted Tea Party!
videos.overview: The gang goes to a tea party and Goofy and Daisy both find a perfect spot.

videos.title: Unhappy Campers
videos.overview: The gang accidentally disturbs a raccoon and her babies at their campsite.

videos.title: Heroes Clean-Up!
videos.overview: The superheroes of Herotropolis are gone! Weasels and the gang make a huge mess.

videos.title: Dino Duck!
videos.overview: Daisy thinks Donald is cheating at their games, but learns good friends should believe each other.

videos.title: Finding Treasure!
videos.overview: Captain Salty Bones needs Mickey and his pals to help him find his beloved lost dog, Treasure.

videos.title: Witchy Worries
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang go in search of a woodsman who disappeared in the Land of Myth.

videos.title: Clarabelle's Pie Day
videos.overview: Clarabelle is overwhelmed by the things she needs to do during Pie Day.

videos.title: Minnie's New Puppy
videos.overview: Minnie adopts a new puppy and isn't prepared to train her.

videos.title: Curse of the Crusty Clam!
videos.overview: Donald opens a giant clam and unleashes a curse.

videos.title: Dream a Little Dream
videos.overview: The gang helps Goofy conquer his fear of dreaming by accompanying him on a fun, sleepytime adventure.

videos.title: Seas the Day!
videos.overview: Mortimer joins the gang on a sailing trip, leading to some stormy surprises.

videos.title: Play Nice!
videos.overview: The gang builds a new snow pal named Rosie, who plays a bit too rough for Sunny.

videos.title: Rescuing the Rutabaga Ruby
videos.overview: The gang helps their friend, Captain Salty Bones, get the Rutabaga Ruby back from the Belching Idol.

videos.title: Goofy Doesn't Like It!
videos.overview: Goofy refuses to try new food during Lunar New Year.

videos.title: Tooth or Consequences!
videos.overview: The Tooth Fairy needs help collecting the large and heavy tooth of Woodsman Willie.

videos.title: The Heroic Games
videos.overview: Pete the Mighty competes in the Heroic Games and underestimates Saiya, a short Mayan hero.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie and friends help Buccaneer Belle, and first mate Cuckoo-Loca brings pirate sidekick parrots to their pirates on Pirate Beach.

videos.title: Salty vs. Pepper
videos.overview: Captain Salty Bones needs the gang’s help to find a treasure before his pirate rival, Pepper Lemon.

videos.title: Just Plane Quackers
videos.overview: Daisy is afraid to fly with the gang in an air rally over the Adventure Worlds.

videos.title: Frannie Takes Flight!
videos.overview: Farfus’ little sister, Frannie the griffin, is ready to fly but is really nervous.

videos.title: No Thrills, Please!
videos.overview: The gang flies the Floaty Coaster to Sunny Gulch to give rides, but Pete and Horace have different feelings about roller coasters.

videos.title: Space Doggies
videos.overview: Pluto and Teddy have a playdate with Zoop Bloop.

videos.title: Ready to Play, Ruthie!
videos.overview: When a new player who won’t share causes his players to quit, Pete calls the gang to play a baseball game.

videos.title: Goofy Dogs!
videos.overview: Goofy helps Lunar Clarabelle learn to make hot dogs.

videos.title: 3:10 to Rocky Road
videos.overview: The Weasels steal a train full of Rocky Road ice cream to have it all for themselves.

videos.title: Please and Thank You
videos.overview: The gang and their pets are invited to a ball, and Mortimer refuses to use good manners.

videos.title: HALT, Tiger!
videos.overview: On Shadow Mountain in the Land of Myth and Legend, Mickey and friends meet Cho Sook, a mythical Korean shapeshifter.

videos.title: You Gotta Be Kitten Me!
videos.overview: Daisy and Minnie help Thalia overcome her fear of cats.

videos.title: King Ludwig's Day Off
videos.overview: King Ludwig spends the day at the Funhouse, so he can do things all by himself.

videos.title: No Horsing Around
videos.overview: Minnie and Daisy have new horses for a show; Daisy learns to take care of her horse.

videos.title: The Kooky Paleontologist!
videos.overview: Von Drake whisks the gang off to Prehistoric World to find hot lava to repair their game.

videos.title: That’s My Jam!
videos.overview: The gang embarks on a journey to gather instruments for a big jam session.

videos.title: Dino See, Dino Do
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang head to Prehistoric World for a sleepover with some baby dinosaurs.

videos.title: Pete the Mighty Baby!
videos.overview: On a visit to meet Pete's mom, Donald and Pete step into a fountain of youth which turns them into babies.

videos.title: For Pete's Sake!
videos.overview: The gang helps Pete the Mighty try to sculpt a statue of himself out of a mountainside, only to be thwarted by Care-abelle's magic.

videos.title: Minnie Golf
videos.overview: Minnie and Martian Minnie play Mini-Golf.

videos.title: No Bear Hugs
videos.overview: Minnie and Martian Minnie play Mini-Golf.

videos.title: Where's Funny?
videos.overview: When Funny isn't around, it's up to Mickey and friends to have a fun day on their own.

videos.title: Cora The Pirate Crab!
videos.overview: Goofy is jealous that Cora the giant crab is Captain Salty Bones' first mate.

videos.title: The Curious Case Of The Kooky Scientist
videos.overview: Von Drake's lab assistants accidentally turn him invisible.

videos.title: Stink, Stank, Stunk!
videos.overview: Mickey and the gang discover the Grand Pumpkin and they must return it to Halloweenville before it rots away.

videos.title: Día de los Muertos
videos.overview: The gang celebrates Día de los Muertos in Mexico City.

videos.title: Mayor Franken-Pete's Very Bad Day
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie, and friends help Mayor Franken-Pete of Halloweenville feel better by using a Calm Down Plan.

videos.title: The Lost Party Rings
videos.overview: Daisy is the ring bearer for Bubble's and Seabiscuit's wedding and she ends up losing the rings.

videos.title: Mickey's Sky-High Birthday!
videos.overview: It’s Mickey’s birthday, and his pals want to make his birthday wish come true.

videos.title: The What About Me Birthday
videos.overview: Kyung Won is having trouble when everyone pays attention to his sister, Ae-Che, on her first birthday.

videos.title: Minnie's Snow Ball!
videos.overview: Minnie’s picnic gets rained out, so she moves the picnic to Fairy Square.

videos.title: The Snow Princess
videos.overview: The gang journeys to Winter Mountain in hopes of meeting the Snow Princess.

videos.title: Santa's Crash Landing
videos.overview: When Santa crash lands in Funhouse Forest, Mickey, and the gang help him deliver presents to Majestica, Halloweenville & Winter Mountain.

videos.title: There's Something About Teddy!
videos.overview: When the gang notices that Teddy is acting differently, they bring him in for a checkup.

videos.title: Finders Keepers?
videos.overview: Goofy finds Care-a-Belle's lost magic grow tool, and things start growing out of control.

videos.title: Majestica's New Troubadour!
videos.overview: King Ludwig brings a new troubadour to the royal court, and the Royal Troubadour worries he'll be forgotten.

videos.title: Minnie's Pod Mod
videos.overview: Minnie feels sad when she doesn't get a cool pod mod to test.

videos.title: Low-Key Coqui
videos.overview: Lost N Found Island folks can't find their coquí friend, Lukey, to thank him for singing.

videos.title: Pinky And The Bees
videos.overview: Pinky shows the gang her favorite tree, but a hive of bees wants the tree to make honey.

videos.title: Crystal Clearwater Vs. The Annoying Algae
videos.overview: The gang needs Crystal Clearwater's help after discovering the Weasels have brought an invasive species.

videos.title: Trolland's Big Adventure!
videos.overview: Trolland goes on an adventure to be King Ludwig's heroic knight.

videos.title: Chickie Boo-Boo, Where Are You?/Playground Heroes!
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie and their pals picnic with Willie and Chickie Boo-Boo. Clarabelle invites the gang to help build the Herotropolis playground.

videos.title: The Trail Less Traveled/Vardavar!
videos.overview: Minnie and Daisy get lost while exploring the Hidden Valley of Sunny Gulch with Clarabelle. Minnie wears the wrong outfit to celebrate the Vardavar.

videos.title: Daisy and the Missing Dream/Daisy's Big Picture
videos.overview: Daisy searches Dreamland for her favorite dream. Daisy is dissatisfied when she wants to take the perfect selfie.

videos.title: Goofy Foot Grommet/The Enchanted Rescue
videos.overview: Goofy gets knocked off his surfboard and becomes scared to try again. When the gang goes on a scavenger hunt, they lose their elephant friend, Ellie.

videos.title: Saving Major Green!/Minnie Safari
videos.overview: The gang helps save Funhouse Forest's oldest tree on Arbor Day. Minnie becomes frustrated when she can't find the elusive Cat-O-Spots on a safari.

videos.title: Fun-A-Palooza!/Missing Buttons and Bows
videos.overview: Minnie is worried her xylophone skills aren't good enough to play at the Fun-A-Palooza concert. When Minnie's items go missing, she thinks her friends are taking them.

videos.title: Goofy's Birthday...in Space!
videos.overview: Goofy's birthday party keeps getting interrupted by Rocket Mouse's outer space emergencies.

videos.title: Windy's Good Deed Days/Can I Borrow Ducky-Doo?
videos.overview: Daisy and Goofy spend the day with Windy and find she spends her time doing good deeds. Daisy lends a special toy to Wheezelene, who has a hard time giving it back.

videos.title: The Dino-Opolis 500/Dino Disco!
videos.overview: Goofy is concerned his dino running partner is too slow for the DinoOpolis 500 race. Donald gets frustrated when he cannot get the moves right to a new dance.

videos.title: Happy Campers
videos.overview: On a camping trip, the gang must help restore Orion the Hunter and other constellations when they accidentally knock them out of the sky.

videos.title: The Giant and the Goof/Call Me Cora!
videos.overview: When Goofy and Willie the giant switch sizes, Chickie Boo Boo goes missing and causes chaos. Mortimer gives everyone nicknames, but Cora the crab doesn't like being called Crabby.

videos.title: Donald vs. the Starcade/Whose Treasure Is It?
videos.overview: Donald becomes distracted when he promises to play a game with Daisy. Mickey becomes too excited to listen to his friends' ideas when the gang searches for Cora's treasure.

videos.title: Daisy Overdoes It/The Good, the Glad and the Goofy
videos.overview: Daisy signs up for too many activities at the Land of Myth's volunteer day. Goofy loses popcorn kernels for the Sunny Gulch Sarsaparilla and must retrieve them.

videos.title: This Cat Doesn't Swim!/Funhouse-made Costumes
videos.overview: Despite Minnie trying, Bast the cat doesn't want to swim at Pete the Mighty's pool party. The gang has to improvise their costumes when they go missing on Halloween.

videos.title: Daisy's Dilemma/The Good Luck Moon
videos.overview: Daisy has trouble choosing between Mickey and Minnie's jack-o'-lanterns for a Halloween competition. When celebrating Chuseok, Ye Eun forgets to make an important dish.

videos.title: One More Thing?/On a Dark and Stormy Night
videos.overview: In Razzle Dazzle Dunes, Kyung Won wants more than the one souvenir his mom told him he could buy. In Halloweenville, Goofy is comforted by his pals when he's afraid of a big storm.

videos.title: Warbler Get Your Geetar!/The Littlest Striker
videos.overview: When Sneezel is too afraid to ask to be a part of a concert, Wheezelene steps in to help. Powerhouse Pete doubts Cuckoo Loca's abilities when she joins in a soccer game.

videos.title: Let's Have Fun, Fun, Fun!/Copycat Pete!
videos.overview: Daisy wants to be the only fan of her favorite band, The Beach Bugs. Pete starts copying Mickey when Mayor Clarabelle asks him to be the square dance caller.

videos.title: Nochebuena at the Funhouse/Hanukkah at Hilda's
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, Panchito and José teach Goofy and the gang about Nochebuena. The gang gets caught in a snowstorm and learns how Hilda celebrates Hanukkah.

videos.title: The Winter Mountain Art Show/Hear Ye! Hear Ye!
videos.overview: Kyle must learn to create art in a new way when he can't use his special paints for the Winter Mountain Art Show. Daisy spoils King Ludwig's big news at his special celebration.

videos.title: Clarabelle's Pie Dilemma/Daisy in Movie Magic Land
Goofy and Pluto Meet Teddy-stein/Stick to the Plan!
Quiet Ness/Happy Pal-entine's Day!
videos.overview: Ness doesn't want to attend a party because she's afraid it will be too loud. The gang goes to Crayon World to draw cards for Pal-entine's Day.
